used.description: Indian Sign Language videos from IIT Madras / AI4Bharat INCLUDE corpus (Sridhar et al., 2020). Landmark sequences extracted with MediaPipe Hands, 30 frames per clip, stored as .npy tensors.

excluded.reason: Used for the separate static/fingerspelling model, not Ver1 temporal words.
Not present in current manifest; not trained into this Ver1 checkpoint.
Not merged into this build (ideology: prioritize when multi-signer depth exists).

limitations: CRITICAL: 1.0 signers/class — model may have learned a person, not ISL.
INCLUDE manifest has only 1 unique signer_id — validation is NOT signer-independent.
95% headline from ideology may not reflect new signers; wild-test accuracy is unknown.
Per-class support is low (~16 videos/class) — high variance on rare signs.
